front_question: What is guaranteed under Article 326 of the Indian Constitution?
back_answer: Article 326 guarantees Universal Adult Suffrage, granting every Indian citizen aged 18 years or above the right to vote in elections without discrimination based on religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.

front_question: Which constitutional article vests the superintendence, direction, and control of elections in the Election Commission of India (ECI)?
back_answer: Article 324 of the Indian Constitution vests all powers of election management, oversight, and control in the autonomous Election Commission of India.

front_question: Explain how the First-Past-The-Post (FPTP) electoral system determines a winning candidate.
back_answer: In FPTP, the country is divided into single-member constituencies. The candidate who secures the highest number of votes (a plurality) in a constituency wins the seat, even if they do not achieve an absolute majority (>50%).

front_question: What is the Model Code of Conduct (MCC) and when does it take effect?
back_answer: The Model Code of Conduct is a set of ethical guidelines issued by the ECI for political parties and candidates regarding speeches, rallies, manifestos, and government announcements. It comes into force immediately upon the announcement of election dates.

front_question: In a mock school election simulation (Act_7.1), what specific verification steps occur at the polling station?
back_answer: 1) Polling Officer 1 verifies voter identity against the official Electoral Roll; 2) Polling Officer 2 applies indelible ink to the left index finger and issues a ballot/slip; 3) Voter enters secret voting compartment to record vote; 4) Returning Officer oversees transparent counting.

front_question: How does the Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) system function alongside Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs)?
back_answer: When a voter presses a candidate button on the EVM ballot unit, the connected VVPAT printer displays a printed paper slip showing the candidate's name, serial number, and symbol for 7 seconds behind a sealed glass window before dropping it into a secure box.

In FPTP, voters vote for individual candidates in single-member constituencies and the candidate with the most votes wins. In PR, voters vote for political party lists in multi-member constituencies, and parties are allocated seats in exact proportion to their overall vote share.

front_question: What regulatory actions can the ECI take if a government minister violates the Model Code of Conduct during campaigning?
back_answer: Under Article 324, the ECI can issue show-cause notices, censure the candidate, temporarily ban them from public campaigning, freeze policy announcements, or transfer non-neutral government officials.
